context: M2 o6. The desk phone rings at 22:50.

lines.speaker: char.carmen_arce
lines.text: Mijo. It's your mother. You know, the one who fed you for thirty years?

lines.speaker: char.carmen_arce
lines.text: Tomorrow, Sunday, two o'clock. Arroz con pollo. You come in a clean shirt.

lines.speaker: char.carmen_arce
lines.text: And you tell me why Carl Mayhew was looking for you at the bodega.

lines.speaker: char.carmen_arce
lines.text: Lonely men don't buy cigars for the whole counter. Two o'clock.
